_meta.description: Frozen production performance + economic baseline, captured BEFORE any M7 authority migration. Per master program §36/§14: thresholds frozen before seeing migrated measurements; not moved later to obtain PASS.

baseline_method.cache_conditions: cold (first run) and warm (subsequent) measured separately where applicable

indexing_baseline.note: Captured from M7.0B freertos_matrix_scaling.json (16 builds). These are the PRE-migration shadow-store numbers. M7 must not regress query latency catastrophically; indexing economics should improve via reuse.

query_latency_policy.rule: Relative production baselines, NOT the old 'query < 5s' research threshold.
query_latency_policy.formula: For each representative query, P95_migrated must be <= max(2.0 * P95_baseline, P95_baseline + 50ms). This detects catastrophic regressions (1ms -> hundreds/thousands of ms) while permitting normal variance. Frozen BEFORE seeing migrated measurements.
query_latency_policy.baseline_capture_status: PENDING — to be captured by BOOTSTRAP gate before M7.1

economic_success_criteria.storage: semantic_storage_bytes does not grow approximately linearly with Build count when semantics overlap heavily
economic_success_criteria.materialization: semantic_materialization increasingly follows changed/new semantics (shared_facts grows, build_private_facts shrinks relative to total)
economic_success_criteria.query_performance: query P95 remains acceptable per formula above
economic_success_criteria.end_to_end: end-to-end indexing shows material benefit, not merely smaller DB size. Frontend cost NOT hidden.

frontend_bottleneck_detection.rule: If frontend_preprocess_parse > 0.7 * total_wall_time at the 16-build scale AND semantic_materialization is already < 0.3 * total_wall_time, classify as ORIGINAL_GOAL_REMAINING_FRONTEND_BOTTLENECK (per §13/§42). Do NOT auto-start a parser project.
